firstStitchTypeIntroduction.condition: the incoming region has no truthy stitch_type
firstStitchTypeIntroduction.nature: normalization default (fallback), not a technical decision
firstStitchTypeIntroduction.input: raw region from hybridDigitize, from the vectorization fusion engine, or from ctx.contours.regions
firstStitchTypeIntroduction.output: same region object plus a guaranteed stitch_type field
firstStitchTypeIntroduction.alreadyPresentInVectorRegions: possible: base44/functions/hybridDigitize/entry.ts can emit stitch_type; when it does, the value is preserved verbatim because of the || fallback
firstStitchTypeIntroduction.relativeToPhysicalWidthMeasurement: BEFORE. Width is measured later, inside enrichAllRegions / EIE skeleton metrics (src/lib/regionBuilder.js), so the default cannot depend on width.

semanticOverride.condition: a semantic object from ctx.semanticMap matched the region centroid (findSemanticForRegion score > -0.3)
semanticOverride.nature: LLM-sourced override, applied before enrichment and before width measurement
semanticOverride.declaredReason: inline comment: 'LLM has visual context we don't — respect it'

adaptiveEngineFixation.effect: any pre-existing stitch_type wins over the EIE/adaptive proposal (adaptStitchType → eieStitchType), so the geometry-driven technique proposal is computed and then discarded
adaptiveEngineFixation.fastModeShortcut: src/lib/regionBuilder.js:352-357 — when useAdaptive is false and the region already has a stitch_type, the adaptive path is skipped entirely

secondForcing.condition: region is not classified as border contour nor as whitelisted dark detail, AND (!f.region_class || f.region_class === 'fill')
secondForcing.calledFrom: src/lib/pipeline/stages/regionBuilderStage.js:126, gated by config.contourSafeMode === true (true in the baseline)
secondForcing.objectsAffected: every non-contour region without an explicit region_class
secondForcing.affectsSatinAndRunning: yes for any region whose region_class is absent — including one whose stitch_type was 'satin' or 'running_stitch'; regions with a non-fill region_class are exempt
secondForcing.regionClassAvailabilityInBaseline: region_class is assigned by regionClassifier, which only runs when config.experimentalDetailPreservation === true. It was false, so no region had a region_class and all 26 regions were forced to fill.
secondForcing.declaredReason: inline comment: 'Respect region_class + detailPreserved from the new classifier — don't force everything to fill'; the f.contour = null line prevents fills from carrying a duplicated contour object and double-rendering on the canvas
secondForcing.protectsExistingFunctionality: yes — it keeps the fill/contour separation single-sourced (standalone contour objects live in contours[]), and it guarantees every non-contour object enters the clipped scanline fill path used by ce01SafeFillMode and by DST export. Removing it without a replacement route would send those objects to the polygon-path branch described in satinCapabilityMatrix.json.
secondForcing.mutationNote: the loop assigns onto the enriched region objects in place; documented, not modified.
